name: Lords of Hellas

categories.label: Won (met a victory condition)
categories.hint: Game ends immediately when a player meets any victory condition.

categories.label: Lands controlled
categories.hint: Warlord: control 2 Lands (a Land = all Regions of one color); 3 Lands in a 2-player game. In a 3-player game the blue Land does not count.

categories.label: Regions with Temples controlled
categories.labelVi: Số Region có Temple kiểm soát
categories.hint: Favored of the Gods: control 5 Regions with Temples.

categories.label: Held fully built Monument for 3 turns
categories.labelVi: Giữ Monument hoàn chỉnh sau 3 lượt
categories.hint: King of Kings: after any Monument is completed, control its Region when 3 turns have passed. Not used in a 2-player game.

winCondition: First player to meet any one: Warlord (2 Lands, 3 in 2-player), Favored of the Gods (5 temple Regions), Monster Slayer (3 monsters), King of Kings (hold Region of a fully built Monument for 3 turns; 3-4 players only).

endCondition.description: Ends immediately when a player meets a victory condition.

notes: family: area-majority (objective win, no points). Based on the 16-page prototype manual (1j1ju) plus BGG/publisher summaries; the retail rulebook PDF could not be downloaded, so thresholds may differ in the final edition.

sources.title: Lords of Hellas rulebook (BGG file, not downloadable)
